title: The one move that turns the gate around

ask.text: Write the stretch it admits.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Sharing by an inverted count carries the rail over the Sill.
The mark lands at 1, and the detent is no longer where it started.

worldFraming.text: Carry the rail over the Sill inverted and the detent changes sides.

ask.text: Write the stretch it admits.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Taking away a cold value is not a count. The rail stays as it is.
Both pans came down by 7, and the mark is at 4.

worldFraming.text: You feel it go over through the handle a moment before you see it.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: Carry the rail over the Sill inverted and the detent changes sides.
